MSP430G2553 Silicon Errata
2.2.1 USCI0 I2C Hang On Stop Condition
The USCI module may hang when a stop condition is received at 400 kHz at TA = 85°C.
Work Around Use a lower bus frequency or toggle UCSWRST.

ti_lines: SPI slave mode loses bytes on fast clocks
Bytes may be dropped when SCLK exceeds 8 MHz at 3.3 V.
Limit SCLK or enable the FIFO delay.
Break detection misfires at high baud.
